purpose: 检验方法是否迁移抽象能力，而不是硬编码当前城市、站点、固件、主体 ID 或答案。

public_variant.target: 一家区域博物馆拟采购馆藏数字化联合服务：扫描 40000 件藏品、建立可追溯 rights clearance，并把被接受的对象写入馆方 repository。
known_unknowns: format interoperability under exact repository version
private throughput, price, rights-risk and staff capacity
separated signing, technical, reservation and museum acceptance authorities
submission, shortlist, award, repository adoption and accepted-object effect

private_variant_truth.material_change: fragile objects must be captured on museum premises and master images may not leave the preservation network
authority_split: museum procurement controls current request, ceiling, submission and award
museum registrar controls accepted-object repository readback
each principal has separate commercial signer and technical/capacity authority
RIGHTS-AUDIT independence authority may reject conflicts

outcome_witnesses.acceptance: award notice for exact joint-bid version
outcome_witnesses.effect: registrar-signed repository readback with accepted object count and rights-record hashes

private_variant_truth.safe_exit_condition: any unresolved ownership claim affecting more than 500 objects blocks full-scope closure and requires a scoped counterproposal or exit

must_preserve: submission, adoption, acceptance and effect separation
must_not_require: CITY, PRIME, FIELD or ASSURE IDs
12 sites, telemetry, firmware 4.2 or edge orchestrator 2.3.1
a Towow-specific object or protocol name
the same workflow topology when the domain demands a different one
migration_evaluation.full_credit_policy: A standards-only CMMN/BPMN/DMN, IAM/policy, commitment and workflow composition may receive full migration credit if it preserves all required distinctions and evidence gates.
